messages:
Sandeep Rao: Quick note — ran a sensitivity sweep on hosted API demand for Q3 through Q4. Sharing three scenarios: baseline (15% QoQ), surge (40% QoQ), and long-tail (5% QoQ). Spreadsheet: https://redwood-internal/sheets/hosted-capacity-sweep

June Park: Thx. Can you paste the GPU-hour delta for the surge case? We need it for finance.

Sandeep Rao: Surge -> ~+12k A100-equivalent GPU hours/month across NA+EU, roughly +400 GPUs (1:1 daily concurrency) peak. If we use 80% utilization target that's ~500 physical GPUs unless we use preemptible bursts.

Chris Lin: Important: APAC demand is lumpy—if NA + EU go up, APAC will need regional headroom due to latency SLOs. How much of that +12k is APAC vs global?

Sandeep Rao: APAC is ~18% of the surge delta (~2.2k hours). The rest is NA (~60%) and EU (~22%). We'll need at least 40-50 GPUs in APAC transiently.

Amina Gomez: Two cost options: 1) short-term leases for peak months (6-9mo) vs 2) buy + ramp (capex). Short leases: ~20% premium vs buy but gives flexibility. Spot/preemptible fleet could cover ~30% of surge at 60% reliability.

June Park: Finance prefers buy if utilization >70% long-term. If surge is transient, leases. Can we model a mixed approach with reserved pool + spot overlay?

Sandeep Rao: Yes — I ran a mixed config: reserve 300 GPUs (buy/long-term reserved), lease 150 GPUs seasonal, and allow 120 preemptible to cover spikes. That keeps unit cost ~15% below pure lease and keeps SLO risk within 2 regional fallbacks.

Chris Lin: Operationally we must ensure KV cache warmup doesn't blow latency on cold starts if we spin up 100+ new instances. What's plan for fast-warm cache?

Sandeep Rao: Proposal: maintain a hot-standby pool with instantiated KV caches (k8s nodes with preloaded model shards) in each region. Warm-up script: `./ops/warm_kv.sh --region eu --count 10` (runs ~6 min). We'll need ~12 nodes in NA/EU to keep p95 < 200ms during scale.

infra-bot: Deploy job triggered: capacity-warmup/1779112233 started by S.Rao. ETA 7m.

Amina Gomez: Also flagging network egress caps — EU colo has a hard 60Gb/s egress limit; adding 400 GPUs could push us over if traffic pattern skews. We should model peak token/sec * avg output bytes.

Sandeep Rao: Good call. Rough calc: peak 1.2M tokens/sec * 0.5 bytes/token ~ 0.6GB/s, times region overlap -> risky. Mitigation: route batch-heavy workloads to NA or use regional throttles.

June Park: Next steps: Sandeep to add mixed-procurement cost sheet + risk matrix. Ops to prototype warm-standby automation. Finance to run capex IRR on buy vs lease. We'll sync Thurs 10am.

Chris Lin: Adding note: can we test spot reliability with a synthetic load for 48h? If preempt rate > 20% we shouldn't rely on it for core customer tiers.

Sandeep Rao: Agreed. I'll schedule a 48h spot soak next week and post logs. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
